extraction.policy_summary: Aegis Logistics states it has adopted an Equal Opportunity Policy in accordance with the provisions of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and rules framed thereunder, described as 'a framework which is committed towards the empowerment of persons with disabilities' that 'aims to provide practical guidance on the management of disability issues in the workplace in accordance with the provisions of the act and its rules.'
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: The filing includes a 'Differently abled Employees and workers' table with a header total of 121 (121 male, 100%), but the detailed breakdown rows immediately below (Permanent, Other than Permanent, Total differently abled employees, and the corresponding worker rows) are all shown as '-' with no numeric value. The header figure of 121 is inconsistent with the detailed breakdown and cannot be reconciled from the text; no unambiguous PwD headcount is disclosed.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: The company answers 'Yes' that its premises/offices are accessible to differently abled employees and workers as per the requirements of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, and separately states 'most of our locations are accessible to differently-abled visitors.' No specific physical features (ramps, restrooms, elevators, etc.) are described.
extraction.culture_practices_details: In connection with its equal opportunity commitments, the company states it has 'zero tolerance for harassment and discrimination of employees at the workplace,' promotes a culture where employees can raise issues with superiors or HR managers, and is 'committed to providing an inclusive work culture and an environment free from any discrimination' that does not treat anyone differently based on, among other things, disability. No PwD-specific ongoing practices (ERGs, flexible work, accommodation response-time commitments) are described.
extraction.compliance_details: The company answers the mandated BRSR statutory questions affirmatively: premises/offices accessible to differently abled employees and workers per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 ('Yes'); an Equal Opportunity Policy is in place per the RPwD Act, 2016; and premises accessible to differently abled visitors ('Yes, most of our locations are accessible to differently-abled visitors').
